item.title: Lady Raiders historic season over after rout by LSU
item.description: Texas Tech headed back into the tiger pit in Baton Rouge on Sunday looking to pull off an upset win over LSU. However, the 2-seed Tigers were too much to handle, as the Lady Raiders were trounced 101-47.

item.title: Red Raiders run out of gas in season-ending loss to Alabama
item.description: 5-seed Texas Tech rode into Sunday's NCAA Tournament Second Round finale off a big-time win over 12-seed Akron. The Red Raiders faced fellow red-tinted foe Alabama with a trip to back-to-back Sweet 16's on the line.

item.title: Lubbock County Commissioners pass next steps for long-awaited Expo Center
item.description: Lubbock County Commissioners are moving forward with the Lubbock County Expo project.

item.title: Local students build unique projects for the Junior Ag Mechanics Show at SASS
item.description: Local students showed off their welding and construction skills at the Junior Ag Mechanics Show at the San Antonio Stock Show.

item.title: Driver accused of killing 2 women in Crosby County booked into LCDC
item.description: The driver in Saturday's fatal collision that killed two people in Crosby County has been charged and booked into the Lubbock County Detention Center.
